description: Yuina at the culture festival: all of HI_S6.BIN, HI_S6B.BIN, HI_S6I.BIN, HI_S6O.BIN (1202 strings; base 0x801E8000). Verified in DuckStation on forced festival days (tools/emu/force_festival.py, hidden emulator; docs/testing.md 'The culture festival'): her answer (S6I) and her PC fortune at the Computer Club exhibit. Not seen: S6, S6B. Layout and flow in game-internals 6ab. The stage shows (Drama play, Band concert, Literature speech contest) are BUNKA_SD.EXN, still Japanese. Natural triggers, other years and moods checked only statically.
